name: boppi
description: Local AI agent security scanner: discovers MCP configs for Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Roo, Continue, Zed, Gemini CLI, Codex, Amazon Q, JetBrains, Goose, and LM Studio, plus installed AI apps and provider-key names. Maps what those agents can reach and reports potential exposure paths. Scans run locally; boppi push can send the sanitized inventory to a Boppi workspace.
author: Melody Manzur
